rules.description: Applicant must be at least 18 years old
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be at least 18 years old to apply for naturalisation as a British citizen

rules.description: Applicant must hold Indefinite Leave to Remain (ILR)
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have Indefinite Leave to Remain before applying for citizenship

rules.description: Must have held ILR for at least 12 months
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have held ILR for at least 12 months before applying for citizenship

rules.description: Must have lived in the UK for at least 5 years
rules.reason_if_failed: You must have lived in the UK for at least 5 years

rules.description: Must not have spent more than 450 days outside the UK in the 5-year period
rules.reason_if_failed: You have spent more than 450 days outside the UK in the 5-year qualifying period

rules.description: Must not have spent more than 90 days outside the UK in the final 12 months
rules.reason_if_failed: You have spent more than 90 days outside the UK in the final year of the qualifying period

rules.description: Must demonstrate knowledge of English, Welsh, or Scottish Gaelic
rules.reason_if_failed: You must pass an approved English language test at B1 level (CEFR) or higher, or have a degree taught in English

rules.description: Must have passed the Life in the UK test
rules.reason_if_failed: You must pass the Life in the UK test before applying

edge_cases.description: Applicant has criminal convictions that may affect good character requirement
edge_cases.action: Application requires enhanced caseworker assessment. Serious convictions may result in automatic refusal. Contact Home Office for guidance.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has previous immigration violations or overstays
edge_cases.action: Good character requirement may be affected. Enhanced caseworker review required. May need to demonstrate rehabilitation period.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has been abroad on Crown service (military, diplomatic, etc.)
edge_cases.action: Time abroad on Crown service does not count toward absence limits. Provide evidence of service.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is married to a British citizen
edge_cases.action: You may be eligible for faster naturalisation route (3 years instead of 5). Use form AN2 instead of AN1.
Use form MN1 for registration as a British citizen (different process for children).

edge_cases.description: Applicant is stateless or would become stateless
edge_cases.action: Special provisions may apply. Contact Home Office for guidance on stateless persons applications.
